# GitHub Copilot Instructions — Gedankenwelten

This project uses a shared AI instructions file: **AGENTS.md** (repository root).

Please read `AGENTS.md` before making suggestions.
It contains the complete project structure, note pipeline (8 steps), quality standards, tag taxonomy, and copyright guidelines.

Key conventions:
- Note filenames use simple hyphen `-` (not em-dash `—`), no umlauts, no colons
- Wikilinks to DenkerVita always use full path: `[[DenkerVita/<Name>]]`
- Zeitgeist notes require a `## Faktencheck` section with `[!success]`/`[!warning]`/`[!danger]` callouts
- Every note ends with `## Weiterdenken` and open questions
